hooks.name: Remind Test Mirror on Module Create
hooks.description: When a new Python module is created in src/cloudshellgpt/, reminds to create the corresponding test file in tests/unit/ following the testing-guide convention.

action.prompt: A new Python module was just created in src/cloudshellgpt/. Per the testing-guide steering, every module must have a corresponding test file. Check if the matching test file exists at tests/unit/test_<module_name>.py. If it doesn't exist, create it with the basic test scaffold structure: docstring, from __future__ import annotations, imports, and a placeholder test class with a TODO comment. Follow the pytest-unit-creator skill conventions for naming and structure.
